name: QTI - Quantum Telecommunications Italy
description: QTI is an Italian start-up that engineers, develops, and produces reconfigurable quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. A spin-off of the Italian National Institute of Optics (CNR-INO), the company serves private companies, government agencies, and research institutions with quantum-secured communication solutions.

products.name: QKD Systems
products.description: Reconfigurable quantum key distribution systems for quantum-secured communication over fiber-optic networks

highlights: Spin-off of the Italian National Institute of Optics (CNR-INO)
Telsy (TIM Group subsidiary) acquired a strategic stake to integrate QKD into Italian telecom infrastructure
Serves government agencies, research institutions, and private enterprises with quantum-secured communications
